GLOW's Variant-Preprocessing Defaults

Source: R/glow_defaults.R
glow_preprocessing_defaults.Rd

Returns the default LD-pruning threshold, rare-variant collapsing threshold and B/PI aggregation method that prepare_glow_input, glow_region_test, filter_variants_ld and collapse_rare_variants use when the caller does not set them. GLOWpipeline's scan engine and the GLOWanalyses base configuration read the same values, so every route applies one convention unless a run overrides it explicitly.

glow_preprocessing_defaults()

Value

A named list with elements ld_threshold (numeric), mac_threshold (integer) and collapse_method (character).

Details

ld_threshold = 0.9

LD pruning removes one variant of every pair whose absolute genotype correlation \(|r|\) exceeds 0.9 (the threshold is on \(|r|\), not on \(r^2\)).

mac_threshold = 10L

Variants with cohort minor allele count strictly below 10 are collapsed into one unit; 0 disables collapsing.

collapse_method = "mean"

The B and PI weights of a collapsed group are aggregated by their mean. The genotypes of the group are always summed.

These are the settings of the methods paper (Zhang, Liu, Landers and Wu, 2026): its simulations excluded variants with MAC below 10 and pairs with \(|r|\) above 0.9, and its UK Biobank analysis collapsed variants with MAC below 10.

References

Zhang, H., Liu, M., Landers, J. E., and Wu, Z. (2026). Integrated weighted association test with application to genetic association studies. The Annals of Applied Statistics, 20(3), 2074-2097. doi:10.1214/26-AOAS2223

See also

prepare_glow_input, filter_variants_ld, collapse_rare_variants

Examples

glow_preprocessing_defaults()
#> $ld_threshold
#> [1] 0.9
#> 
#> $mac_threshold
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $collapse_method
#> [1] "mean"
#> 
glow_preprocessing_defaults()$ld_threshold
#> [1] 0.9
